name: EPRD Summer Day Camp
description_short: A six week city day camp at Pierce Field where children ages 6 to 12 play sports and games, do arts and crafts, and go on field trips, with a free lunch each weekday.
notes: Runs Monday to Friday 8:30 am to 3:30 pm. $300 deposit at registration; balance due July 13, 2026. Field trip and special activity fees are extra and paid in cash. Rain site: Agnes B. Hennessey Elementary School cafeteria, 75 Fort St. The camp says it is not a licensed day care.

sources.note: Researched by Claude from this page. 2026 camp guidelines PDF on the department's RecDesk portal: Pierce Field, 8:30 am to 3:30 pm, June 29 to August 7, ages 6 to 12 as of September 1, 2026, $600 for the six week session, free lunch, no transportation
